expectations.detail: dut:K4_open observed before the boundary (first at seq 2000000001) [BLOCKED: This forbid clause is currently satisfied for the wrong reason: K4 starts de-energized (open) at boot and stays that way -- relay_owner_command_energize() is fully built (firmware/SaftyFW/src/tasks/relay_owner.c) but called by nothing in the current source tree -- so K4_open is already true at sim-time 0, not because the flapping fault genuinely failed to trip anything under S5's real streak-reset logic.]

blocked_on.reason: This forbid clause is currently satisfied for the wrong reason: K4 starts de-energized (open) at boot and stays that way -- relay_owner_command_energize() is fully built (firmware/SaftyFW/src/tasks/relay_owner.c) but called by nothing in the current source tree -- so K4_open is already true at sim-time 0, not because the flapping fault genuinely failed to trip anything under S5's real streak-reset logic.
blocked_on.phase: Phase 7 (link_task) -- link_task exists and already decodes several ESP->Pico commands (PUSH_CONTEXT, CLEAR_TRIP, SET_CONFIG, ROLLBACK, ANNOUNCE_REBOOT...), but not this one. KilnFW already sends SAFETY_CMD_REQUEST_ENABLE (0x02) over the link (safety_link_request_enable(), App/drivers/ uart_bridge.c), yet SaftyFW's link_task.c has no LINK_FRAME_REQUEST_ENABLE_CMD case at all (confirmed against link_frame.h's command list), so relay_owner_command_energize() is never called from anywhere. A genuinely missing decoder, not a wiring omission on an existing pair -- see ROADMAP.md M4's matching finding.
